Definition: adverb of present passive participle of G3670; confessedly:--without controversy.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, homologouménōs means without controversy. It occurs just once, in 1 Timothy.
TheologicalSignificance: I read homologouménōs plainly: without controversy, and I leave it there.
